objective: Enable AWG to govern its own design, implementation, quality, and coordination changes using the same specification-first workflow.
assumptions: The bootstrap specification and checker are the trusted initial seed
Coordinator remains lifecycle authority and AWQ remains quality-policy authority
unknowns: Future successor specifications may refine this policy
invariants: Every AWG design/conceptual change has a formally checked successor specification
Formal-model, oracle, implementation, quality, CI, and release evidence remain distinct
Coordinator owns task revision and lifecycle transitions
AWQ checks the applicable quality and formal-evidence profiles
Changes to the seed, checker, or self-hosting rule require a successor specification
Routine operational maintenance still has a bounded specification
acceptance_predicates: Self-hosting enables only after the required bootstrap ARs are done
An unspecified AWG design change is rejected
Formal checks run before oracle selection and before implementation
A passing quality check cannot substitute for oracle approval or implementation evidence
The policy records its recursion boundary and limitations
